summary: Extended scripts/bench-report.js with v4 W/H/C decomposition (note-mq72538c). readSplit now also counts EXPLORE_TOOLS (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash/Edit/Write) tool_use blocks as explorers. Rows carry W (diffTokens), totalOutput, H=max(0,out-W), explorers, cacheCost. New per-problem model.v4: C=costCache(ON)-costCache(OFF), METRIC=(H_off-H_on)*5 - C, plus 4 win guards (precondition H_off>=2*W_off, fairness both solve>=0.8, margin METRIC>0 AND >1 pooled stdev, corroboration W_on/W_off<=1.1) -> WIN. Renders "## v4 decomposition" section in report.md (per-arm + per-problem + guard PASS/FAIL) and adds v4 to report.json. Added v4 unit tests (explorer count, W/H math, full WIN case, precondition-FAIL case, fairness-FAIL case): 61/61 pass. node --check clean. Not committed.
